page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-192-lssd is an x86_64 instance powered by Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The configuration provides 192 dedicated virtual CPUs across 96 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem features a 504 MB L3 cache alongside support for advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8. Memory capacity is provisioned at 720.0 GB of RAM, equating to 3.75 GB per vCPU, while attached ephemeral storage delivers 12,864 GB spread across 32 local NVMe SSDs. Dedicated accelerators are not included, as GPU count is zero.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-core throughput, characterized by top-tier rankings in stress-ng multi-core testing, PassMark CPU scores, and software compilation via Clang. Memory subsystem throughput is similarly high, registering uncached read bandwidth of 711.18 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 227.52 GB/sec. Application-level performance highlights include high throughput in PassMark database operations, Redis SET workloads reaching over 329 million operations per second, and static web serving data transfer exceeding 173 GB/sec. Single-threaded performance lands within average to top-tier tiers depending on instruction sets, with Geekbench single-core reaching top-tier levels while stress-ng single-core reflects average scores.

In terms of resource allocation, the platform balances substantial compute density and memory capacity with high-capacity local NVMe storage. Because the instance lacks dedicated hardware accelerators such as GPUs, large language model generation speeds fall into average ranges compared to specialized hardware, though CPU prompt processing remains strong via AMX vector extensions. The instance presents a cost-efficient consolidation footprint for workloads capable of saturating 192 threads alongside high local I/O requirements.

Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-192-lssd is suited for distributed database clusters, in-memory caching platforms, large-scale CI/CD build environments, and data engineering pipelines that depend directly on low-latency local storage and massive parallel CPU throughput.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-192-lssd is a general-purpose, high-core instance featuring 192 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor (96 physical cores) and 720.0 GB of RAM. Bundling 12,864 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 32 drives without discrete GPUs, it achieves top-tier results in multi-core compute tests, memory bandwidth, Clang compilation, and Redis throughput. While single-thread benchmarks and CPU-based LLM token generation exhibit moderate performance relative to specialized architectures, the hardware delivers massive parallel throughput and extensive local storage bandwidth. The instance is suited for enterprise relational databases, large-scale in-memory key-value stores, distributed analytics pipelines, and parallel continuous integration build farms requiring high I/O performance.
